facts.text: Northwest Missouri State University includes primary textbook rentals in tuition and fees and provides full-time undergraduate students with a fully loaded laptop computer.

sources.title: Textbooks & Laptop Included* - Northwest Admissions | Northwest
sources.quote: Rental of your primary textbooks is included in tuition and fees for on-campus, undergraduate students.

sources.title: Textbooks & Laptop Included* - Northwest Admissions | Northwest
sources.quote: Full-time undergraduate (at least 12 credit hours) and graduate students (at least 9 credit hours) will also receive a fully loaded laptop to use while studying at Northwest.
